# Diana Barry

## Overview

- **Age:** Eighteen or nineteen (v01–v03); three years older than at the time of her marriage (v04).  <sub>[v1 c2 P62](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0062), [v1 c26 P15](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0015), [v1 c28 P8](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0008), [v4 c1 P2](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0002)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c2 P61](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0061)</sub>
- **Status:** Alive  <sub>[v4 c1 P2](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0002)</sub>
- **Origin:** Orchard Slope, Avonlea, Prince Edward Island  <sub>[v1 c2 P60](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0060), [v1 c8 P37](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0037), [v1 c12 P40](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0040)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Di  <sub>[v3 c29 P10](../source/v03-c29.md#nw-v03-c29-p0010)</sub>

## Appearance

Diana is a very pretty girl with black eyes, glossy dark hair, rosy cheeks, and charming dimples. She has a plump figure, which she occasionally self-deprecatingly compares to a dumpling. In adulthood, she grows somewhat matronly while retaining her bright black eyes, rosy cheeks, and dimples.

_Sources: [v1 c8 P40](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0040), [v1 c12 P21](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0021), [v1 c15 P22](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0022), [v1 c30 P43](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0043), [v1 c33 P12](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0012), [v1 c33 P13](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0013), [v1 c33 P14](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0014), [v4 c1 P2](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0002)_

## Personality

Diana is a good-natured, frank, and affectionate girl who habitually laughs before speaking. She is very agreeable, well-behaved, and polite, though she enjoys playful fun, reading stories, and exchanging innocent secrets with her peers. She holds a deep capacity for loyalty and affection towards those she loves.

_Sources: [v1 c8 P37](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0037), [v1 c8 P40](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0040), [v1 c12 P21](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0021), [v1 c12 P26](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0026), [v1 c12 P27](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0027), [v1 c17 P5](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0005), [v1 c17 P29](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0029)_

## History

Diana Barry grew up at Orchard Slope in Avonlea. When Anne Shirley moved to Green Gables, the two met in the Orchard Slope garden and swore eternal friendship over an imagined running stream. They spent their childhood building playhouses such as Idlewild, roaming the woods, rowing on the pond, creating creative writing stories together, and exchanging notes and secrets. After accidentally becoming intoxicated on Marilla Cuthbert's homemade currant wine, she was briefly forbidden by her mother from associating with Anne until Anne saved her little sister Minnie May during an attack of croup. Diana later attended Avonlea School, where her popularity caused her name to frequently appear on the porch walls. She joined the Avonlea Improvement Society as a young adult and eventually married Fred Wright. A few years into her marriage, she gave birth to a daughter whom she named Small Anne Cordelia in honor of her lifelong friendship with Anne.

- Born in February at Orchard Slope  <sub>[v1 c2 P60](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0060), [v1 c12 P40](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0040)</sub>

## Quotes

> Why, I guess so. I’m awfully glad you’ve come to live at Green Gables. It will be jolly to have somebody to play with. There isn’t any other girl who lives near enough to play with, and I’ve no sisters big enough.  <sub>[v1 c12 P27](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0027)</sub>

> Why it’s dreadfully wicked to swear,  <sub>[v1 c12 P30](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0030)</sub>

> You’re a queer girl, Anne. I heard before that you were queer. But I believe I’m going to like you real well.  <sub>[v1 c12 P37](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0037)</sub>

> Indeed I will, and I’ll never have another bosom friend—I don’t want to have. I couldn’t love anybody as I love you.  <sub>[v1 c17 P5](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0005)</sub>

> Diana Wright will, though. There, mother’s calling. Come.  <sub>[v3 c29 P11](../source/v03-c29.md#nw-v03-c29-p0011)</sub>
